scripts.setup: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs && pnpm install && docker compose up -d && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push
scripts.build:prod: pnpm --filter @wordswipe/shared build && VITE_API_URL= pnpm --filter web build && VITE_API_URL= pnpm --filter admin build
scripts.copy:prod: rsync -az --delete --exclude node_modules --exclude .git --exclude .env --exclude packages/api/dist --exclude packages/shared/dist --exclude backups ./ root@46.225.113.117:/opt/wordswipe/
scripts.api:prod: ssh root@46.225.113.117 'cd /opt/wordswipe && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build'
scripts.db:push:prod: ssh root@46.225.113.117 'cd /opt/wordswipe && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T -w /app/packages/api api npx prisma db push --skip-generate'
scripts.caddy:prod: ssh root@46.225.113.117 'cp /opt/wordswipe/deploy/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && systemctl reload caddy'
scripts.prod-server: pnpm build:prod && pnpm copy:prod && pnpm api:prod && pnpm db:push:prod
scripts.logs:prod: ssh -t root@46.225.113.117 'cd /opt/wordswipe && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f --tail 100 api'
scripts.status:prod: ssh root@46.225.113.117 'cd /opt/wordswipe && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "API: HTTP %{http_code}\n" 127.0.0.1:3001/api/categories'
